cohort: The study included 7196 women with a singleton cephalic fetus, delivering at term after a spontaneous labor from the 2016 French Perinatal Survey.
finding: Early augmentation of labor is frequently practiced in France and is associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Early augmentation of labor was associated with a significantly higher cesarean delivery rate (8.40% vs 6.15%) and an increased adjusted odds ratio for cesarean delivery (aOR 1.45, 95% CI [1.15-1.82]).
